𝗝𝗘𝗡𝗦𝗘𝗡 𝗜𝗦 𝗕𝗔𝗖𝗞 💥

Nvidia's board today chose to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, effective immediately. NVIDIA is currently surging more than 30% on the news. The board says it has received input from senior levels of the US government that his return poses no national security risk.

We don't know the full story yet. The independent investigation is still running, and Huang has committed to cooperating with it. Personally, I have found some of the revalations quite disturbing. More details can come out, and the stock can move sharply again in either direction. 

And that is exactly the point.

Nobody knew the full story on Friday either. Those who sold, or exited the market in general, to wait for clarity, got it this morning, at a price almost 30% higher, and $SPX500 is more than 3% up.

This is why you should be careful to try to time the market, and jump in and out. The news arrives without warning, and 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 𝘁𝗲𝗻𝗱 𝘁𝗼 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲 𝗿𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁 𝗮𝗳𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝗼𝗻𝗲𝘀. I have written this before, but I think it makes sense to repeat it.

Personally, I don't need to predict the next headline. I just stay invested.

What you choose to do, is your choice.
